obligations.note: The only code change raises the in-memory MAX_LINES cap in AppLog.java from 10,000 to 12,000. The message content, masking and log call sites are untouched, so this change cannot put unmasked NPI into a log entry. The registered (sample) control test controls.LoggingControlTest#sampledFlowsDoNotLogNpi ran unskipped and passed on the head commit.

The change names ticket CHG-25795. Erik Brandt (change_manager) approved it on 2026-09-28, before the change was opened, and its components [mortgage.logging] cover AppLog.java, the only touched path.
Declan Farrell gave a code_review approval. He holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is a different person from the author, Nneka Okafor, under every listed email.
Both approvals name the head commit 56361d81, and the change has only that one commit.

run.json records a successful run of ci/run-tests.sh baseline-mortgage on the head commit 56361d81: 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped. That run includes the registered LOG-1 control test (sample coverage), passing. The JUnit reports carry a 2026-10-23 timestamp and a local hostname; this is noted, but run.json ties the run to the head commit.
mortgage.logging is security_sensitive. Kofi Mensah (security_reviewer) gave a security_review approval on the head commit.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers AppLog.java. All ledger entries cover other files, none of which changed, so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1808 changes one constant, the AppLog in-memory buffer size, in the security-sensitive mortgage.logging component. It does not alter what is logged or how values are masked. The ticket is approved by a change manager and covers the component. Independent code review and security review both sit on the head commit, and CI on the head commit passed the full suite, including the LOG-1 control test. No protected paths were touched and no ledger evidence lapses, so the change is accepted; the commit message's mention of 'session' settings does not match the diff, but no session code was changed.
